	type_icon = regular_buildings/keen_weapons.dds
	next_building = keen_weapons_2
	cost_gold = regular_building_cost_tier_1
	cost_prestige = tribal_building_prestige_cost_tier_1
	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 3
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		has_building_or_higher = tribe_01
		scope:holder = {
			NOT = {
				government_has_flag = government_is_wanua
			}
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_tribal = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	character_modifier = {
	}
	county_modifier = {
	}
	province_modifier = {
		stationed_maa_damage_mult = normal_maa_damage_tier_1
		stationed_heavy_infantry_damage_mult = normal_maa_damage_tier_1
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_iron_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_iron
		amount = metal_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				stationed_heavy_infantry_toughness_mult = 0.05
			}
		}
	}

	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_tribal_context_modifier = yes
		directive_to_build_military_modifier = yes
		ai_general_building_modifier = yes
		ai_capital_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_regular_new_building_modifier = yes
	}
}
